study: Confirmation indicators on history, powered: on desk-style pre-square entries across a 400-name liquid sample over ~110 sessions, do ADX trend strength, OBV / A/D confirmation or the pasted article's four-way confluence pick entries that beat both the same name's random later minute and a random other name at the same minute by more than the entries they exclude? And do the operator's 10/8 video setups S3-S7, entered on their own, beat those controls over a 10-minute hold?
registered_at: 2026-10-21, before any script, feature or outcome on this population
origin: indicator_confirm_prereg.json (desk arms, 31 sessions) can only grade H2: its count step (10/21) left H1 half A and H3-H5 in both halves below 100 IN arms, and forward sessions would take ~2 months for ADX and 6-12 months for OBV / A/D / confluence. Operator 10/21: 'how can they be powered' -> chose the history route.
relation_to_desk_study: This is not the desk's opens. It asks whether the indicator adds anything to a desk-style entry on unscreened liquid names (not the movers board, which fades). The desk-arm study still scores tonight and stays the on-desk read; neither result is promoted on the other's evidence.
prior: LOW. prescreen_turn (10/17, same warehouse): %R turns on 400 unscreened names are a random minute (BOTHUP -0.2 bp, t -1.2, n 283k). Every desk entry trigger scored like a random minute (entry-setups-are-noise-equivalent). Earlier confluence scores failed out of period. The structure_pullback S2 count (10/9) found ~0.7% of name-days with an entry.
data: The warehouse (tools/studies/warehouse_fetch.py, ai_reports/warehouse on the mini): 120 sessions 2026-04-27 .. 2026-10-15, universe = US common stock passing the prior-day RAW liquidity rule ($10, 20-day $20M ADV; ETFs/funds excluded; active + inactive). The first 10 sessions are look-back only (structure needs 10 prior sessions), so scored sessions are 2026-05-11 .. 2026-10-15 (~110). Each scored session: a seeded sample of 400 names, int(sha256(f'{day}|indicator-hist-sample').hexdigest()[:16], 16), from names with that day's IEX and SIP bars AND the previous session's IEX bars (a new seed: not prescreen_turn's 400). Split-adjusted bars. No new data is fetched. Halves: A = 2026-05-11 .. 2026-07-29, B = 2026-07-30 .. 2026-10-15 (the median scored session, fixed here). The warehouse is RTH-only (09:30-15:59), split-adjusted, with no quotes and no daily bars. It has been mined by ~10 earlier studies (prescreen_turn, pr_*, trend_dip, resume_square, together_sweep, flat_pace_mid); these IN/OUT splits have not been looked at, but the only clean held-out sample is forward data.

entries.PRE: the desk-style entry: early_entry_honest.pre_flag onsets (both %R lines >= -35, within 15, not a full square, fast rising), on IEX 1-minute bars with the %R lines warmed on the previous session's last 220 IEX bars (as prescreen_turn amended_1), 10:00-15:30, 15-minute refractory per name. The live desk arms on the last pre-square ('last_presquare'); this is its completed-bar analog. Decision minute m = the onset bar's minute + 1. Chosen because the live arm is mostly the last pre-square: in October 1,195 of ~1,706 arm_ok arms were last_presquare (385 last_overbought, 126 last_mid_rise). Decision minute m = onset bar + 1 makes entry one minute later than prescreen_turn's PRE row (conservative); entry at m (onset + 1) is an information cell.
entries.all_minutes_information: every 5th RTH minute 10:00-15:30 of the sampled names, as the base rate (information only).

features: identical to indicator_confirm_prereg.json as amended (amended_3 included) and computed by the same code (indicator_confirm_study.features_at / cell_side): IEX 1-minute RTH bars completed before m, restarting at 09:30; 80% coverage; ADX(14) Wilder; OBV and A/D confirmation at a 30-minute high; C1 from 10:31 with the same seeds, VWAP and legs. SIP-bar features are information only.

hypotheses.H1_adx_trend: IN = PRE entries with ADX >= 25 and +DI > -DI; OUT = other PRE entries with a valid ADX.
hypotheses.H2_adx_chop: IN = ADX >= 20; OUT = ADX < 20; OUT lift_vs_random must also be < 0.
hypotheses.H3_obv_confirm: IN = OBV CONFIRMS; OUT = OBV DIVERGES.
hypotheses.H4_ad_confirm: IN = A/D CONFIRMS; OUT = A/D DIVERGES.
hypotheses.H5_confluence: IN = C1 true; OUT = C1 false (m >= 10:31).
hypotheses.V_video_setups: S3-S7 ONLY (operator 10/21: S2 is dropped here so structure_pullback stays the clean test of S2 with the video's own 3R / 80-minute geometry). Each setup exactly as defined in structure_pullback_prereg.json (swing rule, UP60, rejection / momentum bars, R bounds, 10:30-14:30, every precision and amendment), with this adaptation to the warehouse (no quotes, no daily bars, split-adjusted): (a) the price for the R bounds is the SIP close of the 1-minute bar ending at t; (b) the stale-quote rule (structure_pullback R3) is void; (c) prior close = the last SIP RTH bar of the prior session, prior-session low = the min SIP RTH low of that session; (d) a name missing from any of its 10 prior SIP session files is dropped and counted (~5% of names a day are newly liquid); (e) t is the ET minute of the setup bar's end; the decision minute is t and entry is the SIP open of the 1-minute bar starting at t + 1 (= m + 1 with m = t), net10. Population: EVERY warehouse name with 10 prior SIP sessions (~1,850 a day, not the 400 sample), because setups fire on < 1% of name-days. Graded as standalone entries: lift vs the same-name control and vs the cross control; no OUT group.

outcome: net10 = SIP close of minute m+10 / SIP open of minute m+1 - 1 - 0.10% (early_entry_honest.markout), exit bar before 16:00. Gross, net5, net30 and the measured ~3 bp cost line are information only.
control: (a) SAME-NAME LATER MINUTE: indicator_confirm_study.control_minute (decision minute c in m+1 .. m+60, entry c+1, net10) with the seed tag 'indicator-hist-v1', one per entry, shared by every cell. (b) CROSS-NAME, SAME MINUTE (required, as prescreen_turn amended_1 F3): a random OTHER name from the same population (the 400 sample for H, all V names for V) with bars at m+1 and m+10, seed sha256(f'{symbol}|{day}|{m}|indicator-hist-cross'), same net10; it strips market-wide moves and time-of-day drift.
statistic: Per entry: d = net10(entry) - net10(same-name control); x = net10(entry) - net10(cross control). H1-H5: DiD_d = mean d(IN) - mean d(OUT) per day and DiD_x likewise (days with >= 3 entries each side), day-equal, day-clustered t (df = days - 1). V: lift_d and lift_x = mean d / mean x per day, day-equal, day-clustered t. Name-day-equal versions printed and required. The same-name later control can depend on the feature (trend names drift), so both d and x are graded and must agree.
split: halves at the median scored session (calendar order).
multiplicity: Two families, each one-sided p 0.025 Bonferroni-corrected at df = days - 1: H1-H5 (5 tests) and V S3-S7 (5 tests).
power: OUTCOME-BLIND COUNT STEP first: per cell and half, IN / OUT entries, name-days, DiD days, and projected MDE = (t_crit + 0.84) x sqrt(2) x the day-clustered SE of the per-day (IN control mean - OUT control mean) net10 (V: of the control net10 of the setup's entries); also the mean and t of (IN same-name control - OUT same-name control) per half, to show how far the control itself depends on the feature. Per V setup, the detector funnel (touch / cancel / skip_R / outside_window / entry). No entry outcome is read. A cell-half with < 300 IN entries or < 20 days is UNDERPOWERED and not scored (counts only).
pass: H1-H5, per half: DiD_d >= +5 bp with t >= t_crit AND DiD_x >= +5 bp with t >= t_crit; IN lift_d >= 0; IN mean net10 > 0; name-day DiD_d > 0; DiD_d >= 0 after dropping the 3 names and (separately) the 3 days with the largest share; H2 also OUT lift_d < 0. V, per half: lift_d and lift_x each >= +5 bp with t >= t_crit; mean net10 > 0; name-day lift_d > 0; drop-3 names / days >= 0. A cell PASSES only if both halves pass. FAIL if a scored half has t <= -2 on d or x, or if in BOTH halves the one-sided 97.5% upper confidence bound (estimate + t(0.975, df) x SE) is below +5 bp on BOTH d and x. If d and x disagree (one meets the PASS bar or the FAIL bound and the other does not), the cell is UNDERPOWERED. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: every pairwise AND of H1, H3, H4, C1; ADX terciles; +DI > -DI alone; OBV / A/D NOT_AT_HIGH; C1 legs alone and leave-one-out; 5-minute ADX
H1-H5 as filters on the all-minutes base population instead of PRE
V setups as filters on PRE (PRE entries with a setup entry in the same name in m-15 .. m-1)
SIP-bar features; net5, net30, gross, 3 bp cost; entry at m+2; controls in m+11 .. m+60 only
time split before / at-or-after 11:25 (the warm-up differs from live before ~11:22)
S7 with the indication-high exit read as a markout at the same 10 minutes
board-like name-days: entries where the name is up >= +2% on the day at m (SIP close of m-1 vs the prior session's last RTH bar)
entry at m (onset + 1), to compare with prescreen_turn's PRE
DiD after dropping the top 1% of name-days by share (concentration in a 1,900-name universe)
S2 is NOT scored here, not even as information
calibration: Before scoring: (1) NULL on a driftless synthetic walk with a synthetic prior day (early_entry_honest_null.frame for the prior session and the day), PRE onsets generated by the same warm-%R code on the synthetic IEX bars, the same features, same-name and cross controls, DiD_d and DiD_x for H1-H5; the V scanners S3-S7 run on the same walk with their lift_d and lift_x. Every computed |t| within the two-sided Bonferroni bound over the t values computed. (2) PLACEBO on real data: IN / OUT by a seeded coin flip per entry (sha256(f'{symbol}|{day}|{m}|placebo')), every H cell, DiD_d and DiD_x, same bound. (3) HAND CHECK: 5 entries per V setup (seeded pick) printed with their 1/5/15/60-minute bars and checked against the prereg definition by the operator or reviewer before a READY. Any failure fixes the method before any score.
no_retuning: every threshold of indicator_confirm_prereg.json (as amended) and structure_pullback_prereg.json, the PRE rule, the sample size and seed, the window, refractory, hold, cost, the 300-entry / 20-day power floor, the 5 bp MDE bar and the split are fixed. Any other threshold is a new prereg.
if_pass: provisional: the cell must also not be negative on the desk-arm study (indicator_confirm), must repeat on >= 60 earlier sessions (a new warehouse fetch before 2026-04-27, after hours, data account) and on >= 20 forward sessions after 2026-10-15, then a result-skeptic review of the positive, before any gate, engine change (publishing signals.adx included) or arm.
if_fail: H1-H5: the cell is closed as a filter on desk-style pre-square entries on the free feed for effects >= 5 bp. V: the setup is closed as a 10-minute entry; the video's 3R / 80-minute geometry stays untested here (S2's is structure_pullback's).
declared_deviations: PRE is the completed-bar analog of the live last-pre-square arm; live adds admission, spread, RVOL and tape gates that this sample does not apply
the 400-name sample is unscreened liquid names, not the movers board, which fades (the-universe-fades-at-every-horizon)
%R warm-up is the previous session's last 220 RTH IEX bars; live warms on extended hours
V setups read SIP bars (as structure_pullback); H features read IEX
V uses bar closes, not NBBO mids, for the R bounds and has no stale-quote rule (no quotes in the warehouse)
